name: get_fruit
description: Get nutritional facts for a specific fruit. Returns calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar, and fiber per 100g (e.g., 'apple', 'banana').

name: list_fruits
description: List all available fruits with their nutritional profiles. Returns name, calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar, and fiber for each.

name: get_by_nutrition
description: Find fruits matching a nutritional range. Specify nutrient type (calories, sugar, fat, carbs, protein) and min/max values to filter results.

nutrient.description: The nutrient to filter by. One of: calories, sugar, fat, carbohydrates, protein.
